title: Explainable AI and Quantum-Guided QSAR/QSPR Modeling of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Therapeutics Loading on 2D Nanomaterials
description: Fully reproducible computational pipeline and data archive for the study of the pristine inorganic boron nitride nanocage B36N36 as a loading scaffold for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) therapeutics. Includes: GFN2-xTB relaxed drug/cage adsorption energetics for 30 organic drugs, resolving two regimes (25 physisorb, 5 chemisorb via covalent B-O/B-N bonds; the 3 square-planar Pt(II) agents fall outside the GFN2-xTB + RDKit build); a single seeded AutoDock Vina v1.2.7 docking run against human PARP1 (PDB 4UND) written directly into the master table; a leak-free nested 5x5 cross-validated RidgeCV surrogate with OECD Principle 3 applicability domain; and an end-to-end master script (run_entire_study.py). Neither descriptor QSPR endpoint is predictive; the model-free chemisorption/physisorption outcome is the robust result. Every value in the manuscript is computed from this pipeline; no descriptor or energy is estimated from an empirical formula. v2.0.0 recomputes the adsorption set with relaxed complexes, unifies and seeds the docking source, and makes all manuscript statistics CSV-driven.
